# mistershell_canary_catalog (Data Source)

Reads the Canary service catalog, including version, service definitions, settings schemas and prerequisites. Requires MisterShell 2.1 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_canary_catalog" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `catalog` (Dynamic) Native catalog object containing schema_version, catalog_version, services, settings_schemas and prerequisites.
- `id` (String) Catalog identity.
